Title: Dodging first strike : steal , destroy equip . Answer please

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <ungeri01.1...@scilab.uct.ac.za>,
Eric G Knight <unge...@scilab.uct.ac.za> wrote:
>
>Someone who knows or can quote from the other rule book (DTR .. I think)
>Please Answer.

No. The DT hasn't discussed this, so you'll have to make due with the
rules. :-(

>
> 1) I know a dodge cancels a first strike , but does it cancel a
> first strike : Destroy (or steal) equip .
> Some people say you can't dodge attack at you weapon , .. so a dodge
> does not cancel a "first strike : steal ( Destroy weap) .

The only attacks that aren't negated by dodge are the ones that are
directed at your retainers. (Or non-offensive strikes like Combat Ends),

So you can protect your equipment by dodging - even when the destroy attempt
is at first strike.
